source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Judges 6–12 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 230 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Retain the vineyard comparison and clan/tribe names rather than explaining away the image.
Keep the pointed hand image and refusal based on uncaptured kings.
Preserve Gideon’s threat of bodily torture and threshing image without endorsing it.
Retain peace beside the threat without harmonizing it into a harmless promise.
Keep approximate survivors and exact stated dead without historical adjustment.
Keep Heres as a location, with possible sunrise interpretation noted.
Keep the source’s taught wording while making the implements of bodily harm explicit; note textual alternative.
Keep killing explicit, beyond the earlier tower threat.
Read the difficult where-question as asking identity or appearance, noting its literal form.
Preserve maternal kinship, oath and personal motive for killing.
Retain order to the firstborn, refusal and fear without adding shame.
Keep the proverb-like challenge, executions and distinctive ornaments.
Retain hereditary proposal and the people’s attribution of rescue to Gideon.
Retain Ishmaelite designation without replacing it with Midianite; clarify whose jewelry.
Keep the exact weight with implied shekel unit identified, and every excluded category.
Keep the cult object unexplained in form, infidelity metaphor and harmful outcome.
Render bodily descent clearly and preserve plural wives and exact sons.
Retain the distinct relationship, location and father’s naming agency.
Preserve recurring relapse and named covenant deity without a modern doctrinal gloss.
